title: Red Hat Security Advisory: dpdk security update
description: Multiple security vulnerabilities have been identified in the Data Plane Development Kit (dpdk) packages used in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10. These include memory size validation errors, heap overflows, out-of-bounds writes, use-after-free, type confusion, infinite loops, and buffer overflows affecting various components such as vhost, vhost-crypto, and the nfp vDPA driver. The vulnerabilities could allow a guest to cause host memory corruption or denial of service. Red Hat has issued an important security update addressing these issues.
